Container.Name: spelunkr-bridge
Container.Overview: Turns the retro channels on spelunkr.tv into live TV with a full guide for Jellyfin, and lets you add your own channels built from YouTube playlists. In Jellyfin add an M3U Tuner with http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:8765/playlist.m3u and an XMLTV guide with http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:8765/epg.xml. A fan project, not affiliated with spelunkr.tv.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: Web port for the playlist, guide and streams

Config.Name: Config folder
Config.Description: Saved schedules. Put a channels.json here to add your own YouTube channels (see the examples folder in the repo).

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: How Jellyfin reaches this container, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:8765

Config.Name: Intel GPU
Config.Description: For Quick Sync / VAAPI encoding. Remove if you have no Intel GPU (it then uses the CPU).

Config.Name: GPU render node
Config.Description: The node Jellyfin uses (Dashboard - Playback - Transcoding - QSV Device), e.g. /dev/dri/renderD128. Empty tries each one.

Config.Name: Extra options
Config.Description: Other options, e.g. --skip vacation-slides --no-vhs-cards (see the README)

Config.Name: Update yt-dlp at start
Config.Description: Keeps the YouTube channels working when YouTube changes things
